description: Variants of the audit suite's store (core conformance/audit_world.py build_world: entries on both sides of an NA key succession, an observation, a judgement, an archive record), each verified by the Python reference verify_evidence_events; the TypeScript SDK agrees on every case. Entries dropped or the run started mid-store; executor keys placed by the store (registered and retired by position or time); the key succession recorded at its lead's boundary, signed otherwise, not in the history, malformed; the archive record signed by another key, tampered, malformed; a range with all, none or each but one of its cited entries (prior). A case runs under key_histories[history] (genesis, successions, root key) or na_public_keys; cited (when present) indexes the cited entries in the pool. expected.failures and warnings: (store_sequence, reason) in the order found; counts as nonzero.
